data.exact_reserve_text: There were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2011 and all of these years combined produced a surplus which contributed both to the calendar year result and the closing 2012 account result. A long running disputed claim,which affected the 2011 underwriting year, was settled in July producing a satisfactory reserve release.

prior_year_events.impact_description: settled in July producing a satisfactory reserve release

named_events.loss_description: rates flattened after the small increases seen in areas affected by Hurricane Sandy the year before

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3010 reported a net prior-year release in 2014 of approximately GBP 8.25m. This release reflected favourable development on closed years 2007-2011 (including the settlement of a long-running disputed claim affecting the 2011 underwriting year) which contributed to the calendar year profit. The main business mix is marine/cargo and the release is consistent with surplus emergence on closed marine years.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross "movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" note was present in the provided text. Prior-year development was computed by summing the per-year-of-account profits for 2012 and 2013 from the results table (3,644k + 4,608k = 8,252k), treated as a net release (-8.252m). Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the Balance Sheet prior-year comparative (26,688k). No explicit gross PYD note or per-LOB PYD amounts were provided; LOB-level movement is inferred from narrative (marine/cargo focus) and therefore has reduced confidence.
